meta.name: scientific-writing
meta.description: Generate publication-ready methods sections, figure legends, supplementary tables, and data availability statements from ENCODE analysis provenance. Implements the scientific documentation standards requiring complete metadata reporting. Use when the user needs to write methods, generate figure legends, create supplementary tables, draft data availability statements, compile tool citations, or auto-generate any publication text from their ENCODE analysis. Trigger on: methods section, figure legend, supplementary table, data availability, tool citations, publication writing, manuscript, write methods, methods draft, write up, write-up, paper writing, reproducible methods.
